'''Barriga''' was a merchant who sold supplies to the guard towers in the [[Borderlands]]. 

==Activities==
Barriga was on his way to [[Heeth Tower]], a guard tower in Northern [[Kandor]], to resupply the soldiers who were guarding it, when his caravan was attacked by the swarm of [[Shadowspawn]] attacking the Borderlands. After the attack he was found by [[Samma N'Sei|three men with red veils]]. The men who found him killed the unarmed and wounded Barriga on sight. Barriga first believed they looked like Fades, then upon a closer look decided that they resembled [[Aiel]], leaving the idea that there may be Aiel who have thrown away all ideas of ''[[ji'e'toh]]'' and have sworn to the Dark One. In the last book of the WOT series it is revealed that these Aiel are [[Samma N'Sei]].

== Trivia ==
* Barriga is named for Miguel Barriga, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
